authenticity_review: The image demonstrates exceptional photorealism with professional-grade lighting, depth of field, and texture rendering. Minor AI artifacts exist: slight kerning irregularity in 'SPEEDSTER' text (legible but imperfect) and subtle fusion at the robot's left arm-torso junction lacking crisp mechanical definition. These are severity-1/2 issues that don't significantly undermine overall authenticity. The perceptual_quality_auditor noted only 'slight darken' (severity 0.2), confirming no major graphics-level distortions. Overall quality approaches reference-level product photography.
